spans.s: अपुंस [apuṃsa], m. (˚पुमान्) Not a man, a eunuch; पुमान्पुंसो$- धिके शुक्रे स्त्री भवत्यधिके स्त्रियाः । समे$पुमान्पुंस्त्रियौ वा क्षीणे$ल्पे च विपर्ययः ॥
अपुंस्का [apuṃskā], f. A woman without a husband; नापुंस्कासीति मे मतिः
अपुंस्त्वम् [apuṃstvam], The state of a eunuch, impotent state.
अपुच्छ [apuccha], a. Without tail. -च्छा N. of a tree (Mar. शीसु).
अपुण्य [apuṇya], a. Not virtuous or holy, wicked, bad; ˚कृत् one who does not perform meritorious deeds, or who commits unrighteous deeds.
अपुत्रः [aputrḥ], Not a son. a. -पुत्रकः (˚त्रिका f.) Having no son or heir.

अपुत्रिका [aputrikā], The daughter of a sonless father, who herself has no male child; one who is not appointed by her father to beget male issue for him on failure of a son; cf. अकृता. -कः The father of such a daughter.
अपुनर् [apunar], ind. Not again, once for all, forever. -Comp. -अन्वय a. not returning; dead. -आदानम् not taking back or again. -आवृत्तिः f.
'non-return', exemption of the soul from further transmigration, final beatitude.
भवः not being born again (of diseases also).
final beatitude; तुलयाम लवेनापि न स्वर्गं नापुनर्भवम्
knowledge of the Supreme Soul which tends to this step.
अपुराण [apurāṇa], a. Not old; modern, new.
आपूरण [āpūraṇa], a. Becoming full. -णम् Filling, making full; गर्त˚ कृतम्
Comp. अर्थ a rite or ceremony which is not in the interests of the doer.
not the principal object of the soul.
अपूरुष [apūruṣa], 1 Lifeless, inanimate (as wood &c.) अदो यद् दारु प्लवते सिन्धोः पारे अपूरुषम्
Not nourished or fed, lean, not fat.
Not loud or violent, soft, low (as sound).
(In Rhet.) Not feeding or assisting (the meaning), irrelevant (मुख्यानुपकारिन्), regarded as one of the arthadoṣas (faults of the sense or meaning); as in the instance given under S.
विलोक्य वितते व्योम्नि विधुं मुञ्च रुषं प्रिये, the adjective वितत 'expanded', as applied, to the sky, does not in any way help the cessation of anger and is, therefore, irrelevant.
अपुष्प [apuṣpa], a. Flowerless, not flowering. -ष्पः The glomerous fig-tree. -Comp. -फल, ˚द bearing having neither fruits nor flowers; fruits without flowering.
(लः, दः) the jack tree (Mar. फणस). Artocarpus Integrifolia.
अपुस् [apus], n. Ved. Shape, body = वपुस्
अपूपः [apūpḥ], [न पूयते विशीर्यते, पू-प. न. त. Tv.]
A small round cake of flour, meal &c. (Mar. वडा, घारगा, अनरसा &c.), thicker than ordinary cakes and mixed with sugar and spices; कृसरसंयावं पायसापूपमेव
; अपूपं गुरवे तं च सामृतं स न्यवेदयत् ।
अपूपीय [apūpīya] अपूप्य [apūpya], अपूप्य [अपूपाय हितं, छ यत् च] Belonging to, intended for, अपूप. -प्यम् Flour, meal.
अपूरणी [apūraṇī], The silk cotton tree (शाल्मली). Bombax Heptaphyllum (Mar. सांवरी).
अपूर्ण [apūrṇa], a. Not full or completed, incomplete, deficient, imperfect; अपूर्णमेकेन शतक्रतूनाम्
. -र्णम् Incomplete number or fraction. -Comp. -काल a. premature, untimely. (-लः) premature or incomplete time; ˚ज abortive.
आपूर्ण [āpūrṇa], p. p. Filled &c.; आपूर्णश्च कलाभिरिन्दुरमलः
Not preceded, not having existed before, like of which did not exist before, quite new; ˚र्वं नाटकम् Ś.1; ˚र्वं राजकुलम्
Strange, extraordinary, wonderful; अपूर्वः को$पि बहुमानहेतुर्गुरुषु
; अपूर्वो दृश्यते वह्निः कामिन्याः स्तनमण्डले । दूरतो दहतीवाङ्गं हृदि लग्नस्तु शीतलः ॥ Ś.
; singular, unexampled, unprecedented; अपूर्व एष विरहमार्गः Ś.6; अपूर्वरूपा दारिका
; अतो$- पूर्वः खलु वो $ नुग्रहः Ś.7; अपूर्वकर्मचाण्डालमयि मुग्धे विमुञ्च माम्
Unknown, unacquainted, stranger; अपूर्वो$प्यथवा विद्वान् य

(In phil.) 'That unseen virtue which is a relation superinduced, not before possessed, unseen but efficacious to connect the consequence with its past and remote cause and to bring about at a distant period or in another world the relative effect. -Colebrooke.
र्वम् The remote consequence of an act (as the acquisition of heaven which is the result of good deeds), (Mīmāṁsā). -

Virtue and vice (पापपुण्यम्) as the eventual cause of future happiness or misery. -र्वः The Supreme Soul (परब्रह्म). -Comp. -कर्मन् n. religious rites the power of which on the future is not seen before. -पतिः f. one who has had no husband before, a virgin; ˚तिः कुमारी Sk. -वादः discussion or talk about the Supreme Soul. -विधिः an authoritative direction or injunction which is quite new; it is of four kinds; कर्मविधि, गूणविधि, विनियोगविधि and प्रयोगविधि.
अपूर्वता [apūrvatā] त्वम् [tvam], त्वम् Not having existed before, incomparableness, unparalleled or extraordinary nature; अपूर्व- त्वात्प्रबन्धस्य
अपूर्ववत् [apūrvavat], ind. Singularly, unlike anything else; दृष्टो$पि शैलः स मुहुर्मुरारेरपूर्ववद्विस्मयमाततान Śi.4.17.
अपूर्विन् [apūrvin], a. Having not enjoyed the married life with a wife before. अपूर्वी भार्यया चार्थि वरुणः Rām 3.18.4.
अपूर्वीय [apūrvīya], a. Relating to the remote consequence of an act.
आपूपम् [āpūpam], A kind of metal (perhaps tin).
Fond of cakes, eating cakes (with benefit).
Forming an ingredient of cakes, good for cakes. (as गुड). -कः A baker; confectioner.-कम् A multitude of cakes. (अपूपानां समूहः).
रः Flow, current, large flood, quantity; स्वेदापूरो युवतिसरितां व्याप गण्डस्थलानि Śi. 7.74; हर्षभरापूरपीडनोत्फुल्लया दृशा
Filling, making full; मन्दानिलापूरकृतं दधानो Śi.3.21.
आपूर्यमाण [āpūryamāṇa], a. Becoming full, being filled; आपूर्यमाण- मचलप्रतिष्ठं समुद्रमापः प्रविशन्ति यद्वत्
; ˚पक्षः the crescent or waxing moon; आपूर्यमाणपक्षस्य पुण्याहे Bṛi.
